tables.name: budget_lines
tables.description: Federal budget line items from the Budget in Brief documents, FY2009-10 → FY2026-27.
tables.notes: Rs million. Each printed row carried 1–4 numeric columns; is_own_year_be = TRUE marks the document's own-year Budget Estimate, which is the only column safe to string into a time series. The low-numbered 'Budget at a Glance' tables extract noisily and item wording drifts between years — match with ILIKE and sanity-check.

columns.name: doc_fy
columns.description: fiscal year of the source document

columns.name: col_index
columns.description: 0-based column position in the printed row

columns.name: n_cols
columns.description: how many numeric columns that row had

columns.name: is_own_year_be
columns.description: TRUE = own-year Budget Estimate (the reliable column)

tables.name: district_indicators
tables.description: Every district-level indicator in Data Darbar, one row per district × indicator × year.
tables.notes: Long format so heterogeneous sources share one table. Filter `kind = 'indicator'` for the measures themselves; kind='quality' rows carry the sample size and small-n flag for the same prefix, and kind='provenance' rows record borrowed estimates. Survey groups suppress cells with n<30 upstream, so an absent row can mean 'suppressed' as well as 'not collected'. DOUBLE-COUNTING TRAP: where a district was split after Census 2017 (see the *_boundary_change provenance rows) both halves carry the SAME 2017 figure for the combined pre-split area, so summing a 2017 count across all districts overstates the total. Filter those rows out, or sum the 2023 year instead.

columns.name: district_key
columns.description: normalised join key used across Data Darbar

columns.name: dataset
columns.description: source dataset (Census 2017/23, PSLM 2019-20, LFS, HIES, PDHS…)

columns.name: year
columns.description: census year for two-year census groups, else NULL

columns.name: value
columns.description: numeric value (units implied by the label)

tables.name: file_catalog
tables.description: Index of every source file collected for the warehouse, with its upstream URL.
tables.notes: parsed_into_db = FALSE means the file is catalogued but its contents are not in any table here (mostly scanned PDFs). Use this to check coverage before concluding data is missing.

columns.name: source_url
columns.description: upstream URL at PBS / Finance Division

columns.name: parsed_into_db
columns.description: TRUE if its contents are in a table here

tables.name: lsm_qim
tables.description: Monthly Quantum Index of Manufacturing (large-scale manufacturing).

columns.name: yoy
columns.description: % change on same month a year earlier

tables.name: lsm_sector_indices
tables.description: LSM indices by manufacturing sector, annual and monthly, with CMI weights.
tables.notes: weight is the sector's share in the index (per the stated base year).
tables.source: PBS LSM / Census of Manufacturing Industries

tables.name: mpi_districts
tables.description: Alkire-Foster multidimensional poverty index by district, from PSLM 2019-20 microdata.
tables.notes: M0 = H × A. Censored headcounts c_* are the share of people who are both poor and deprived in that indicator (%). low_n=1 marks districts whose sample is too small to be reliable — filter them out for rankings.

columns.name: H
columns.description: headcount ratio — % of people who are MPI-poor

columns.name: A
columns.description: intensity — average share of weighted deprivations among the poor (%)

columns.name: low_n
columns.description: 1 if sample below the reliability threshold

tables.name: national_accounts
tables.notes: Units vary BY TABLE: levels are Rs million (tables 2–5, 8–11), growth rates and shares are percentages (tables 6, 7a/b). Always read table_name before aggregating. Item labels on the Macro/Main-Aggregate sheets are best-effort.
tables.source: PBS National Accounts annual tables (2015-16 base)

columns.name: table_sheet
columns.description: sheet name in the PBS workbook

columns.name: value
columns.description: value — unit depends on the table

tables.name: tehsil_nightlights
tables.description: Night-time light radiance by tehsil and year (June VIIRS composites).
tables.notes: One row per tehsil × year. Population-weighted mean radiance. Tehsils flagged nl_lowc in tehsil_satellite sit near the sensor's noise floor — their year-on-year movements are mostly noise.

tables.name: tehsil_satellite
tables.description: Tehsil-level (ADM3) satellite measures: relative wealth, population, night-lights.
tables.notes: RWI is Meta's Relative Wealth Index — note it USES night-time lights as one of its own inputs, so rwi and the light columns are NOT independent measurements; a correlation between them is partly mechanical. Lights are June VIIRS radiance, population-weighted. The full year-by-year series is in tehsil_nightlights.
tables.source: Meta/Data for Good RWI, WorldPop 2020, NOAA VIIRS DNB monthly composites

columns.name: dk
columns.description: district_key of the parent district (joins to district_indicators)

columns.name: nl_growth
columns.description: % change in radiance, first to last available year

columns.name: nl_lowc
columns.description: 1 if radiance is near the noise floor (treat growth as unreliable)

columns.name: nl_latest
columns.description: radiance in the most recent June (VIIRS, nW/cm²/sr)

tables.name: trade_hs8
tables.description: 8-digit HS imports and exports, by commodity and partner country, FY2015-16 → FY2024-25.
tables.notes: Values are THOUSAND rupees. fy_* are full fiscal-year (Jul–Jun) cumulative figures; month_* are June alone. country IS NULL marks the commodity total row — country rows sum to it, so filter one or the other or you will double-count. Years missing here exist only as PDFs upstream (see file_catalog).
tables.source: PBS External Trade Statistics (annual fixed-width TXT + D-10 workbooks)

columns.name: country
columns.description: partner country; NULL = all-countries total for that HS8

examples.title: Ten poorest districts
examples.sql:
SELECT rank, name, prov, mpi, H, A
FROM mpi_districts
WHERE low_n = 0
ORDER BY rank
LIMIT 10;

examples.title: Female literacy, 2017 vs 2023
examples.sql:
SELECT district, province,
       max(value) FILTER (year = '2017') AS lit_2017,
       max(value) FILTER (year = '2023') AS lit_2023,
       round(max(value) FILTER (year = '2023')
           - max(value) FILTER (year = '2017'), 1) AS change
FROM district_indicators
WHERE indicator = 'literacy_ratio_female'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY change DESC;

examples.title: Top import partners, FY2024-25 (Rs bn)
examples.sql:
SELECT country, round(sum(fy_value_kpkr) / 1e6, 1) AS rs_bn
FROM trade_hs8
WHERE direction = 'import' AND fiscal_year = '2024-25'
  AND country IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY rs_bn DESC
LIMIT 15;

examples.title: What Pakistan exports most (FY2024-25)
examples.sql:
SELECT hs8, any_value(commodity) AS commodity,
       round(sum(fy_value_kpkr) / 1e6, 1) AS rs_bn
FROM trade_hs8
WHERE direction = 'export' AND fiscal_year = '2024-25'
  AND country IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY rs_bn DESC
LIMIT 20;

examples.title: Real GDP growth by year
examples.sql:
SELECT year, round(value, 2) AS growth_pct
FROM national_accounts
WHERE table_sheet = 'Table 6' AND item LIKE 'D GDP%'
ORDER BY year;

examples.title: Federal defence budget over time
examples.sql:
SELECT doc_fy, item, value_rs_mn
FROM budget_lines
WHERE is_own_year_be AND item ILIKE '%defence%'
ORDER BY doc_fy;

examples.title: Do lights track wealth? (tehsils, by province)
examples.sql:
-- Note: Meta's RWI uses night-lights as an input, so this correlation
-- is partly mechanical. Read it as consistency, not as validation.
SELECT prov,
       count(*) AS tehsils,
       round(corr(rwi, ln(nl_latest + 0.01)), 3) AS corr_rwi_lognl
FROM tehsil_satellite
WHERE nl_lowc = 0
GROUP BY 1
HAVING count(*) >= 5
ORDER BY 3 DESC;

examples.title: Night-lights, tehsil trajectories since 2020
examples.sql:
SELECT s.name AS tehsil, s.prov,
       max(l.radiance) FILTER (l.year = 2020) AS y2020,
       max(l.radiance) FILTER (l.year = 2026) AS y2026,
       s.pop
FROM tehsil_nightlights l
JOIN tehsil_satellite s USING (tehsil_id)
WHERE s.nl_lowc = 0 AND s.pop > 200000
GROUP BY 1, 2, 5
ORDER BY y2026 / nullif(y2020, 0) DESC
LIMIT 20;

examples.title: Urbanisation vs multidimensional poverty
examples.sql:
SELECT d.district, d.province, d.value AS pct_urban_2023, m.mpi
FROM district_indicators d
JOIN mpi_districts m USING (district_key)
WHERE d.indicator = 'urban_proportion' AND d.year = '2023'
  AND m.low_n = 0
ORDER BY m.mpi DESC;
